steps.title: Locate the compilation error in MainActivity.java

steps.title: Remove intentional syntax error

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compatibility in MainActivity.java

steps.title: Confirm android namespace settings in AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Removed package attribute and validated namespace declaration to avoid XML validation and manifest merging warnings.

steps.title: Confirm resource bindings in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Ensured that the calculator button resource IDs matched those in activity_main.xml layout structure.

steps.title: Review target SDK and Gradle build configuration
steps.description: Removed third-party nanohttpd dependency in build.gradle to ensure strict compliance with environment rules.

steps.title: Validate application metadata package configuration

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
